summary_ja: 特定順位参照型クレジット・デリバティブ（ファースト・トゥ・デフォルト型を除く）を信用リスク削減手法として用いない。
summary_en: Nth-to-default credit derivatives bought (other than first-to-default) are not recognized as credit risk mitigation.

terms.ja: 特定順位参照型クレジット・デリバティブ

paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach shall not use nth-to-default credit derivatives (excluding first-to-default credit derivatives) as a credit risk mitigation technique.
